The patch
`0001-rpcinfo-stack-buffer-overflow-in-rpcinfo-rpcbaddrlis.patch`
fixes CVE-2026-16277 and can be dropped when updating to rpcbind
1.2.9. The patch
`0002-rpcinfo-stack-buffer-overflow-in-rpcinfo-rpcbdump.patch` fixes
CVE-2026-16461 and, as of 2026-08-25, this hasn't been yet fixed by
upstream.
